title: Named-Insured Cancellation Terms by Valuables Floater Tier
content:
When the named insured cancels a Larkspur Valuables Floater midterm, three tier terms shape the unearned premium: the basis on which unearned premium is figured, the share of it retained under a short-rate basis, and the premium kept at minimum.

| Tier | Unearned premium basis on a named-insured cancellation | Share of unearned premium kept on a short-rate cancellation (percent) | Premium kept at minimum on a named-insured midterm cancellation (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | short rate | 10 | 25.00 |
| Valuables Floater Select | pro rata | 0 | 25.00 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | pro rata | 0 | 25.00 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | pro rata | 0 | 25.00 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | pro rata | 0 | 50.00 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | pro rata | 0 | 100.00 |

## Questions the table answers

**Which tier cancels on a short-rate basis?** Only the Valuables Floater Classic. Its retention is 10 percent of the unearned premium.

**Do the pro-rata tiers retain any share of unearned premium?** No; their short-rate retention is 0.

**What is the minimum kept?** 25.00 USD on the Classic, Select, Preferred and Prestige tiers, 50.00 USD on the Collector and 100.00 USD on the Private Client.

**Hypothetical retention figure.** On a Valuables Floater Classic, an unearned premium of 80.00 USD under the short-rate basis has 8.00 USD (10 percent) retained.
